result.instructions: Tools for TeamUp, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes TeamUp data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run goteamup_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run goteamup_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run goteamup_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. goteamup_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: goteamup_get_authenticated_application
tools.title: Get the authenticated application
tools.description: Show the API application this token belongs to and the businesses (providers) it can reach, with their numeric ids — a cheap way to confirm the token works and to find the value for GOTEAMUP_PROVIDER_ID. TeamUp: GET /auth/application.

tools.name: goteamup_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: Search and list the business's customers (members and leads). Filter by free text (email and name), CRM status, active memberships, age or family. Deferred fields such as field_values, credit_balance or sms_account can be added with expand. TeamUp: GET /customers.

query.description: Free-text match against email and name.

autocomplete.description: Prefix match from the start of email and name fields.

status.description: CRM status slugs, as shown in a customer's `status` field; pass 'null' for customers without a status.

active_memberships.description: Only customers holding one of these membership (plan) ids.

family.description: Only customers in this family id.

deleted.description: Filter by deleted (true) or not deleted (false).

expand.description: Comma-separated related fields to expand into full objects (dot-nested, max depth 4), e.g. customer,event.instructors.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return (dot notation for nested), e.g. id,name,starts_at.

tools.name: goteamup_get_customer
tools.title: Get one customer
tools.description: Fetch one customer by id: name, email, family role, lead flag, CRM status, created date. Use expand for deferred fields, e.g. field_values,credit_balance,staff_assignments. TeamUp: GET /customers/{id}.

expand.description: Comma-separated related fields to expand into full objects (dot-nested, max depth 4), e.g. customer,event.instructors.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return (dot notation for nested), e.g. id,name,starts_at.

tools.name: goteamup_list_events
tools.title: List events (classes and appointments)
tools.description: List scheduled sessions — classes and appointments — with start/end time, status, capacity, attending and waitlist counts, instructors, venue and offering type. Filter by time window, instructor, venue, offering type, status or occupancy. TeamUp: GET /events.

starts_at_gte.description: Only events starting at or after (ISO 8601 timestamp, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z).

starts_at_lte.description: Only events starting at or before (ISO 8601 timestamp, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z).

ends_at_gte.description: Only events ending at or after (ISO 8601 timestamp, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z).

ends_at_lte.description: Only events ending at or before (ISO 8601 timestamp, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z).

instructors.description: Only events taught by these instructor ids ('me' for your own).

venues.description: Only events at these venue ids.

offering_types.description: Only events of these offering type (class type) ids.

occupancy_status.description: Only events matching at least one of these occupancy states.

tools.name: goteamup_create_customer
tools.title: Create (invite) a customer
tools.description: Add a new customer to the business as staff. By default TeamUp emails them an invitation to claim the profile; set send_invitation_email=false to add them silently. TeamUp: POST /customers.

invitation_note.description: A personal note included in the invitation email.

send_invitation_email.description: Send the invitation email (TeamUp default: true).

tools.name: goteamup_register_customer_for_event
tools.title: Book a customer into an event
tools.description: Register a customer for a class or appointment, optionally using a specific customer membership, or comped (free). Returns the attendance id. Undo with goteamup_unregister_customer_from_event. TeamUp: POST /events/{id}/register.

customer_membership.description: The customer membership id to book with (omit to let TeamUp choose).

comped.description: Book as comped (no membership use / charge). Default false.

annotations.title: Book a customer into an event

tools.name: goteamup_unregister_customer_from_event
tools.title: Remove a customer from an event
tools.description: Cancel a customer's booking for a class or appointment. is_late_cancel=true records it as a LATE cancel, which can trigger the business's penalty rules — leave it unset unless asked. The response says whether it counted as late. TeamUp: POST /events/{id}/unregister.

is_late_cancel.description: Record as a late cancellation (may incur penalties). Omit unless explicitly requested.

annotations.title: Remove a customer from an event

tools.name: goteamup_confirm_attendance
tools.title: Check a customer in
tools.description: Confirm that a customer attended an event (check them in). Returns the updated attendance. TeamUp: POST /events/{id}/confirm_attendance.

tools.name: goteamup_log_crm_interaction
tools.title: Log a CRM interaction
tools.description: Record a call, email, meeting or contact with a customer or lead, with an optional note and call outcome. Requires a super_admin-level token. TeamUp: POST /crm/interactions.
